notes.title: Creating No Strangers 2.0 From Scratch
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello,[/h2]

[h3]You may know me as Xeirel. Today, I’d like to share my thoughts with you not just as a game developer, but also as a fellow player.
This post is packed with updates and details — but most importantly, it’s about how I’ve started rebuilding No Strangers from scratch.[/h3]

[h3]🎮 The First Birth of No Strangers[/h3]
Originally, No Strangers was a test project I started during university. I had some experience with Unity, but I had never developed a multiplayer game before. Back then, although Mirror Networking was easier to learn, I chose to use Unity’s Netcode for GameObjects.

Throughout development, I tried to learn, experiment, and implement features by trial and error. Unfortunately, over time this caused the project to become overly complex and nearly impossible to maintain. Looking back at my old source code... I often can’t even tell what I was thinking 😅

Thankfully, I’ve gained a lot of experience since then.

[h3]💼 Other game: Digital Market Simulator[/h3]
During this time, I began working on another game called Digital Market Simulator with two close friends. Because of that, I couldn’t focus on No Strangers for a while.

But now I’ve created a new project and officially started working on No Strangers 2.0 from scratch!

To summarize, here are the main differences between the old version (No Strangers 1.0 - Legacy) and the new one (No Strangers 2.0 - WIP), including added and planned features:

[h2]✅ NEW FEATURES[/h2]
🌍 Multiple playable maps
👤 Custom player models can now be loaded (Steam Workshop support is planned)
🧭 Revamped UI system — Main menu and pause menu are now unified
🔒 Advanced authentication system:

Players who fail Steam authentication
Players who don’t have the server password
Players you personally block
→ All of them are strictly denied access. A highly secure system is in place.

🚶‍♂️ Client-Side Prediction Movement
Player movement is simulated both on client and server, then synchronized.
→ This prevents speed hacks and unfair lag-related issues.

👀 Spectator Mode
You can now join ongoing games as a spectator.

🎮 GameMode System
Create your own game modes with unique rules.
Adjust spawn behavior, movement types, and more.
→ You’re no longer limited to classic No Strangers gameplay — sandbox and experimental modes are now possible!

🎙️ New Voice Chat System

Old system used Steam’s voice infra and RPC for transmission (which caused delay and lag).

Now:
Audio is captured directly from the device
Noise is reduced using rnnoise
Encoded via Opus
Sent in packets, decoded by recipients
→ In testing, performance was very close to Discord (even better with lower latency 💀).

[h2]🔜 PLANNED FEATURES[/h2]
🔧 Mod API
The game source will remain closed, but I plan to offer a Lua-based custom API for modding.

🎒 Advanced inventory system
Items, clothing, weapons, and more can be stored.
Can be disabled depending on the game mode.

🤖 AI Players
Both offline and online AI players will be supported.
They can act as teammates or enemies.

🚀 Optimization
Better 3D models, more efficient occlusion culling.
→ Strong focus on performance.

[h2]📢 ABOUT DEVELOPMENT[/h2]
This time, I’m not rushing anything. I want to build a solid and scalable foundation for the game.

I’ll share screenshots and videos occasionally, and I plan to do community polls to collect feedback on specific features.

[h2]👉 You can join our Discord server or follow my upcoming Patreon page for updates and behind-the-scenes posts.[/h2]

I’m not a millionaire, nor a famous developer. The only way I can be heard... is with your help.
I’d love to see you in our community. 🙏

🧪 BETA TESTING
As development progresses, we’ll begin a beta testing phase.
I’ll be inviting volunteer testers from the community.

Super excited for this part! 🧡

[h2]❓ FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS (Q&A)[/h2]
Q: Will it be released as a separate game?
[b]A:[/b] No, it will be released as an update. You’ll still be able to play the legacy version via beta branches.
Q: Will it still just have the classic mode and map?
[b]A:[/b] No. Thanks to the new GameMode system, new modes and maps will be added over time.
Q: Will there be Steam Workshop support?
[b]A:[/b] Yes, it’s one of my goals and I plan to implement it.
Q: Will the classic “Who is the Killer?” mode change?
[b]A:[/b] Yes. New roles and gameplay mechanics will be introduced.
Q: Can I play solo?
[b]A:[/b] Yes. Single-player compatible modes and AI players will be supported.
Q: When will version 2.0 be released?
[b]A:[/b] I can’t give a specific date, but some of the core systems are done. I’ll keep sharing updates on Discord and Steam.
Q: Will cosmetic DLCs still be usable?
[b]A:[/b] Yes.
Q: Will the game’s atmosphere change?
[b]A:[/b] Yes. Graphics, sound, and ambiance will be more immersive. I want players to feel like they’re part of the world.
Q: Will system requirements change?
[b]A:[/b] No.
Q: Will it support Steam Deck and Linux?
[b]A:[/b] Yes, it will be playable on platforms like Steam Deck and Linux.

[h2]Q: Where the hell are the Discord Server and Patreon links??
[b]A:[/b] Right here [url=https://discord.gg/RxznmEFmdf]Discord Server[/url] and [url=https://www.patreon.com/c/Xeirel]Patreon[/url] 🥀[/h2]

notes.title: Join Us And Be Part Of The Game!
notes.notes:
Hello, my dear players,

Since I changed my phone and Steam Guard device, I have a 72-hour restriction on my account, so I won't be able to release version 1.0.3 to the public branch for the remaining 2 days. In this version, I fixed things like Japanese font bugs, map bugs, and added an interface for lobby settings while in the waiting area, so you can adjust simple settings such as the number of player killers who are hosts, the number of protectors, etc. Other than that, I've made a lot of fixes and I'd like to thank the nice people here on Discord for letting me know about some bugs and ideas.

For those of you who know me, I take care of my community and I'm there as much as I can be. I can't develop very fast on my own, but I try to keep the game up to date as much as I can, and a lot of that is based on what you guys want, sometimes by voting or taking note of your ideas.

You can be a part of this game by joining my Discord server and subscribing to my YouTube channel. I also try to support all the creators who help me spread the word about my game, even if they are small accounts with a small audience, so we can be more effective if we grow our audience.

Confidential information: I add some players' names or what they share to the game map as a souvenir.

I love you guys...

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@XeirelSoftware
Discord: https://discord.gg/32XYCqdV

FAQ

Q: Why doesn't the game open or closes as soon as it opens?
A: You may not meet the system requirements or one of the background windows may be interfering. I try to keep it as optimized as possible, but Unity HDRP only allows so much.

Q: Why is my voice in-game not getting through to players the way I want it to?
A: We use Steam for voice communication, so you must set your voice communication settings correctly via Steam.

-

Q: Why do I have so much lag when playing the game?
A: NO STRANGERS uses a P2P network infrastructure, which means you are paired with the player who set up the lobby, not a dedicated server, so if the HOST PLAYER who set up the lobby has a bad connection or device, you will be affected. So I can't do anything about your connection problems.

-

Q: I can't connect to some lobbies, or my friends can't connect to my lobby, why is this happening?
A: This can happen for a few different reasons. Some of the possible reasons include:

VPN or Firewall Restrictions: If you are using a VPN or your firewall restricts certain ports, this may make it difficult to access some lobbies. Try turning off the VPN or allowing the game's required ports on the firewall.

Connection Quality and Latency: Since the game relies on a peer-to-peer (P2P) connection structure, your connection quality and latency with other players may affect your access to the lobby. High latency or poor connection quality may cause you to be unable to connect to some lobbies.

NAT Type and ISP Restrictions: Some internet service providers (ISPs) in particular may restrict P2P connections. You can check to see if your ISP imposes any restrictions on P2P connections, or you can review your modem settings to resolve issues with NAT type.

If you continue to experience connection problems, try turning off the VPN if possible and using a reliable, stable network connection.

notes.title: DO NOT BELIEVE THE SCAMMERS!
notes.notes:
Hello,

Based on the latest information I have received and the video recordings I have seen, do not believe people who introduce themselves as DEVELOPERS or TEAM MEMBERS in the game!

(They also give my name or the names of people in my team in the game, don't forget them)

I'm the only developer in the game, and you can tell it's me by the yellow particles on my head and the developer and company icon to the left of my name in the player list.

There are no visual features that distinguish our friends in the security area, but if you are a host, you will see that you can't kick them off the server, so you can tell.

We investigate these amateur liars one by one and ban them permanently, but they can come with different accounts or as different people. They don't do it because they think it will be cool, I think there is a bad intention in it.

It's hard to believe, but the names on the characters were the main cause of the game's lag, especially in alphabets like Chinese, it was reloading the TMP Text component every frame, so we were experiencing a huge framerate drop. To solve this, we removed the fade effect of the names, and in technical terms, we made sure that if the variables are the same, they will not reload. So you will no longer experience lag. I've tried it and I approve it.
